original.target_description: Unresolved target: EIT/oral narrative description conflicts with source anticipatory-looking experiment; candidate tests in notes.

notes: Identity verified from cover citation and manuscript title page: Southgate, Senju, and Csibra (2007), Action Anticipation through Attribution of False Belief By Two-Year-Olds, Psychological Science 18(7):587–592, DOI 10.1111/j.1467-9280.2007.01944.x. Canonical text is a full accepted/refereed primary manuscript with Methods, Results, Discussion and references, not an abstract or secondary account. No PDF supplied. Target description (relationship between EIT scores and oral narrative task performance) conflicts with this infant false-belief experiment. Manuscript p.4 contains Participants, not an EIT/oral narrative test. Row correspondence is unresolved, so statistics remain null and target_match unknown. Candidates only: final infant sample 20; 16 additional exclusions: 11 inclusion-criterion failures, 2 looking away, 2 looking at neither door, 1 calibration failure. Principal first-saccade test: 17/20 correct, two-tailed binomial p = .003; between-condition comparison: 9/10 versus 8/10, one-tailed Fisher p = .5. Secondary looking-duration location effect: F (1, 18) = 5.21, p = .035, partial eta-squared .22. Window-by-condition interaction described as nonsignificant without printed statistics. Candidates are not target extractions; requested metric alone cannot identify a test. No N inferred from df or summed. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
